description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Townhome! * Directly on the Beach with Deeded Beach Access* 3 Beach Front Balconies and 4 King Bedrooms* Sun Deck and New Private Pool - Heated for add'l $70/nt* Golf Cart Available- Gas-powered 6-seater golf cart available for convenience on site through 3rd third-party vendor. Please contact the host for more details* 6 Complimentary Bikes * Gated Path to the Beach is shared only with neighboring property. * FREE Seasonal Beach Service - 4 Chairs and 2 Umbrellas (March 1-Oct 31)* Across from Boutique Retail and Restaurants: including The Perfect Pig Grill* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* 2 miles to Seaside! Enjoy activities like free outdoor movies* Stay Cool and Comfortable with a 2025 New A/C System* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service **This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.** **This property has exterior cameras on the side of the home, facing the driveway, and a beach cam as well as a ring doorbell camera****There is a limit of 4 parking spots (medium sized vehicles) for this unit**Beach Love is a 5 bedroom, 4 bath townhome located in a prime location directly on the beach off Scenic Hwy 30A! Come relax on one of the three balconies and soak in the emerald green gulf views, or head directly out the backdoor down the boardwalk to the beach. This beautifully decorated townhome features a bright, white remodeled kitchen with granite countertops and all new stainless steel appliances. The living area boasts a new 52' inch flat-screen TV, and a balcony showcasing endless views of the gulf. With four king bedrooms and a bedroom with 2 queen-over-queen bunkbeds, this beachfront townhome sleeps a maximum of 14 guests. Your family will love the new private pool, sundeck, and barbecue area and the added convenience of an outside shower, so you can rinse off after a long day at the beach. Come make Beach Love a family vacation tradition!Located in Seagrove Beach, Beach Love is two townhomes, East and West, located directly on the beach. A variety of restaurants and retail shops are within walking distance on Scenic Hwy 30A. This fantastic location offers quick access to Seaside and Rosemary Beach! Also enjoy exploring the many art galleries, and more in nearby Watercolor and Grayton Beach.The Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Queen-over-Queen Bunkbeds2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomMaster Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite BathroomArea Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous.30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
